findings.claim: Owned descendants can still write after observation cleanup. R15-3 promises termination of the process tree; the implementation only signals the original process group, and skips even that group after communicate() reaps the root during KeyboardInterrupt.

manifestations.trigger: A real root spawns a same-group grandchild, then the observer receives KeyboardInterrupt and the root exits during subprocess.communicate()'s interrupt wait.
manifestations.observed: KeyboardInterrupt propagated after 0.315 s; root returncode 0; grandchild wrote late.marker after return. communicate() reaped the root before don_nhom, so returncode is non-None and no group signal is sent.

manifestations.trigger: A real grandchild starts a new session and retains the output pipe; the observation times out.
manifestations.observed: Returned after 0.522 s with TimeoutExpired / DON KHONG HET; root returncode -15; detached grandchild wrote late.marker afterward. This is within R15-3's tree requirement, unlike the separately owner-accepted R15-4 observation residual.

evidence.observed: Normal timeout control: 0.322 s, root rc -15, no late marker. Detached and KeyboardInterrupt variants both leave late markers. Probe uses real processes; no changes to H.

additional_evidence.observed: Scratch mutant removing SIGKILL still passes all 8/8 runner lock cases, including the existing child/grandchild timeout case. This exposes an untested cleanup dimension; supplied removal-of-cleanup mutants do die.

suggested_fix.where: chay_quan_sat/don_nhom and tu_kiem_chay. Process ownership and cleanup belong at the spawn/communicate boundary, not in the downstream zone classifier.
suggested_fix.how: Keep a stable, explicitly owned containment identity through interruption and cleanup; ensure descendants are terminated before releasing/reaping that identity. Do not simply signal an old numeric PGID after reap. Meet the process-tree requirement with descendant containment/tracking that covers setsid/setpgid, or obtain a new owner-approved spec revision explicitly narrowing that guarantee. The current executor declaration alone does not amend R15-3.
suggested_fix.locking_test: Add the real interrupted-parent/same-group-grandchild and detached-grandchild probes with healthy controls. Include a grandchild that ignores TERM so a mutant omitting KILL fails. Assert bounded completion, retained diagnostics, no post-return markers, and an unrelated control process surviving. Existing cleanup-removal and root-only mutants must keep failing for the intended reason.
suggested_fix.new_risks: Signalling a recycled PGID or PID can kill unrelated work; descendant scans can race with reparenting and spawn. Prefer stable containment/handles and bounded cleanup. Stronger containment may require platform capability and a revised scope rather than an unsafe numeric-ID workaround.

repeat_evidence.observed: Fresh scratch directories: normal timeout 0.333s/no marker; detached 0.537s/late marker; interrupted parent 0.319s/late marker. Reproduced.

findings.claim: A relative symlink to the current interpreter is missed by the realpath recognition rule because la_python resolves the logged executable in the reviewer cwd rather than the launch cwd. A sole unhooked child can read a tracked out-of-zone file and all three vung operations still report SACH.

evidence.observed: Standard interpreter and absolute symlink controls: read_confirmed=true, python_con=1, bat_dau_con=0, KHONG_DO_DUOC. The same symlink launched as ./linked with -I: read_confirmed=true, realpath equals /usr/local/bin/python3.13, python_con=0, bat_dau_con=0, SACH. Three-operation fixture targets each operation separately; whole_vung=SACH and all individual results SACH in all three trials.

findings.scope: This is the same interpreter reached by a symlink, not a copied or renamed binary with a different realpath. Realpath equality is explicitly inside R15-4. The owner-accepted copied-interpreter, shell and aggregate-surplus residuals are unchanged and do not cover this case.

suggested_fix.where: HOOK_SRC subprocess/exec spawn records and la_python/doc_log; the event producer must retain the launch-path context before the consumer classifies the executable.
suggested_fix.how: Resolve executable identity in the actual launch context while recording the event, or record sufficient cwd and resolution data for an equivalent comparison. Preserve the existing basename regex and the accepted limits; do not widen the regex. Handle subprocess cwd overrides as well as current-directory changes.
suggested_fix.locking_test: For each vung operation, launch the same interpreter through an absolute symlink and a relative symlink from a cwd different from the reviewer cwd, as the sole -I/-S/-E child. Both forms must be counted and classified KHONG_DO_DUOC. Hooked controls must report the actual out-of-zone read. A mutant that drops launch-context resolution must fail the relative-path case.
suggested_fix.new_risks: PATH lookup and cwd overrides must follow actual launch semantics; post-execution symlink resolution can race with deletion or replacement. Record only necessary path identity, not the whole child environment, and keep the accepted copied-interpreter residual explicit.

notes: Round 2 of 3 per assignment. Executor attempt 3/3 is exhausted; this verdict grants no new executor attempt, push, merge, LIVE or workflow dispatch. Coordinator/owner must resolve the remaining class under the protocol checkpoint.
R15-1 aggregate exit1 is reasonable: original per-run codes remain explicitly printed and saved; the three boundary codes are not collapsed into semantic predicates.

R15-3 process tree cannot be silently redefined as original group/session. The documented setsid/setpgid limitation has no R15-3 owner waiver; it is distinct from R15-4's accepted observation limitation. The pre-reap signalling claim also fails on real KeyboardInterrupt.

R15-4 supplied mutants do die at their declared targets; PYTHONHOME restores copied-interpreter library discovery and retains the hook. Regex unchanged. The absolute-symlink lock misses the relative-launch-context failure PR2-C06.
Spec r15 has not received independent spec approval. This review checks r15 against code; no independent spec approval or human audit is asserted.

Full ab/base/vung and full registry gate were not independently rerun. H full was independently executed exactly once; H light and the registry consumer both passed. Raw executor baseline/vung/registry-gate artifacts were inspected, not promoted to fresh measurements.

Assurance review_deferred denotes no approval from this changes_requested verdict, not absence of review; actual independent cross-family reviewer/executor pair is recorded. Human audit has not been performed.

Final H/tree and status match the initial checkout; worktree/index diffs empty. Pre-existing ignored .codex/ path unchanged; its content hashes were not captured at the initial endpoint. All reviewer writes stayed in /tmp outside the supplied repository. No GitHub writes.
